description: Human-authored narrative summaries for Twi Translation Benchmark Lab stories.

summaries.STORY-001: Ama wakes up in her village, asks her grandmother Nana Adwoa for breakfast, eats warm porridge, and heads outside to play with friends.
summaries.STORY-002: Kofi, Abena, and Kweku wait under a mango tree for their father, who arrives late from the market along muddy paths with a surprise sack of gifts.
summaries.STORY-003: Maame Efua, an elder great-aunt, walks peacefully through the village on market day, paying respects at the chief's palace.
summaries.STORY-004: In a village classroom, teacher Mr. Asante asks about the river's origin and gently encourages shy students not to fear making mistakes.
summaries.STORY-005: Nine-year-old Kweku recalls the memorable childhood morning when a wandering goat chewed through his school notebook pages while he fetched water.
summaries.STORY-006: At a wide, chilly riverbank, young Yaa recoils from the cold water while her older cousin Esi teasingly compares her to a cat avoiding wet paws.
summaries.STORY-007: On Friday evening under the sacred odum tree, the village chief and elders gather to resolve community disputes and discuss serious affairs.
summaries.STORY-008: Eight-year-old Adwoa shares her handmade doll, wearing an orange dress and beads, with her four-year-old sister Akua at bedtime.
